verses.en: Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind, and said,
verses.sm: Ona tali mai ai lea o le ALU ia Iopu mai le afa, ua faapea mai,

verses.en: Who is this that darkeneth counsel by words without knowledge?
verses.sm: O ai ea lenei ua na faapouliuligia laʻu pule i upu e le o i ai le poto?

verses.en: Gird up now thy loins like a man; for I will demand of thee, and answer thou me.
verses.sm: Ina fusi ia lou sulugatiti e pei o le tagata malosi; O le afioga a le Atua ta Iopu faailoa mai ia ia te au.

verses.en: Where wast thou when I laid the foundations of the earth? declare, if thou hast understanding.
verses.sm: O ifea sa e i ai ina o ou faavaeina le lalolagi? Ina faaali mai ia pe afai ua e iloa mafaufau.

verses.en: Who hath laid the measures thereof, if thou knowest? or who hath stretched the line upon it?
verses.sm: O ai ea na ia fuafuaina ai, pe afai ua e iloa? O ai foi ua na faataoto i ai le fua?

verses.en: Whereupon are the foundations thereof fastened? or who laid the corner stone thereof;
verses.sm: Ua tuuina ea ona faavae i luga o le a? O ai ea foi na na tuuina ifo lona maa tulimanu;

verses.en: When the morning stars sang together, and all the sons of God shouted for joy?
verses.sm: ina o pepese faatasi fetu O le taeao, ma alalaga fiafia atalii uma o le Atua.

verses.en: Or who shut up the sea with doors, when it brake forth, as if it had issued out of the womb?
verses.sm: O ai foi na ia pupuni le sami i puipui ina ua oo mai e peiseai na sau mai le manava?

verses.en: When I made the cloud the garment thereof, and thick darkness a swaddlingband for it,
verses.sm: ina ua ou faia le ao mona ofu ma le pogisa ma mea e aui ai;

verses.en: And brake up for it my decreed place, and set bars and doors,
verses.sm: ina ua ou tuu atu i ai foi ona tuaoi, ma avane i ai faamaufaalava ma puipui;

verses.en: And said, Hitherto shalt thou come, but no further: and here shall thy proud waves be stayed?
verses.sm: ma ou fai atu i ai, E te oo mai iinei, a e te le sopoia; o iinei foi e pau mai ai ou galu faamaualuluga.

verses.en: Hast thou commanded the morning since thy days; and caused the dayspring to know his place;
verses.sm: Talu le amataga o ou aso ua e pule ea i le taeao? Ua e faasino atu ea i le tafa o ata le mea e aliali mai ai,

verses.en: That it might take hold of the ends of the earth, that the wicked might be shaken out of it?
verses.sm: ina ia tago atu i tuluiga o le lalolagi, ma ia lulueseina ai o e amio leaga?

verses.en: It is turned as clay to the seal; and they stand as a garment.
verses.sm: E liua o. ia e pei o le omea i le faamaufaailoga, ona latou tutū mai ai lea e pei se ofu.

verses.en: And from the wicked their light is withholden, and the high arm shall be broken.
verses.sm: E aveesea foi i e amio leaga lo latou malamalama, ua gauia foi le lima o le ua faamaualuga.

verses.en: Hast thou entered into the springs of the sea? or hast thou walked in the search of the depth?
verses.sm: Ua e oo atu ea i puna o le sami? po ua e fealualuai ea i mea loloto o le moana?

verses.en: Have the gates of death been opened unto thee? or hast thou seen the doors of the shadow of death?
verses.sm: Ua faaalia ea ia te oe faitotoa o le oti? po ua e iloa ea faitotoa o le ata o le oti?

verses.en: Hast thou perceived the breadth of the earth? declare if thou knowest it all.
verses.sm: Ua e mafaufau ea i le lautele o le lalolagi? Ina faaali mai ia, pe afai ua e iloa ia mea uma.

verses.en: Where is the way where light dwelleth? and as for darkness, where is the place thereof,
verses.sm: O ifea le ala i le mea e noo ai le malamalama? O le pouliuli foi o ¿fea le mea e mau ai la,

verses.en: That thou shouldest take it to the bound thereof, and that thou shouldest know the paths to the house thereof?
verses.sm: ina ia e momoli atu ai i lona tuaoi, ina ia e iloa foi le ala i lona fale?

verses.en: Knowest thou it, because thou wast then born? or because the number of thy days is great?
verses.sm: Ua e iloa ca ia mea ina ua fanau mai oe i ia ona po, ina ua tele foi le faitau o ou aso?

verses.en: Hast thou entered into the treasures of the snow? or hast thou seen the treasures of the hail,
verses.sm: Ua e ulu atu ea i mea e teu ai le kiona? ua e vaaia ea foi mea e teu ai ie uato‘a?

verses.en: Which I have reserved against the time of trouble, against the day of battle and war?
verses.sm: o mea ia ua Ou tuu ma ona po O le puapuaga, ma le aso e tau ai le taua.

verses.en: By what way is the light parted, which scattereth the east wind upon the earth?
verses.sm: O ifea le ala e vaevaeina atu ai le malamalama, e faasalalauina ai le matagi mai sasae i luga o le lalolagi?

verses.en: Who hath divided a watercourse for the overflowing of waters, or a way for the lightning of thunder;
verses.sm: O ai ua vaevaeina o alavai mo uaga, ma le ala mo le uila o le faititili?

verses.en: To cause it to rain on the earth, where no man is; on the wilderness, wherein there is no man;
verses.sm: ina ia to mai le ua i le laueleele, e le o i ai se tagata; ma le vao, e le aina e tagata,

verses.en: To satisfy the desolate and waste ground; and to cause the bud of the tender herb to spring forth?
verses.sm: ina ia malie ai le mea ua taaligoligoa ma le mea ua zaogao; ina ia faatupuina ai foi le vao iti.

verses.en: Hath the rain a father? or who hath begotten the drops of dew?
verses.sm: E ai ea se tama o le ua? poo ai ua fanaua le suasau?

verses.en: Out of whose womb came the ice? and the hoary frost of heaven, who hath gendered it?
verses.sm: E sau ea le vaito‘a mai le manava o ai? O le sauto‘a foi mai le lagi o ai ea na na fanaua?

verses.en: The waters are hid as with a stone, and the face of the deep is frozen.
verses.sm: Ua ufitia le vai e peiseai se maa, ua toʻa foi le fogatai.

verses.en: Canst thou bind the sweet influences of Pleiades, or loose the bands of Orion?
verses.sm: E te mafai ea ona nonoa i noataga o Kima? Pe e te mafaia foi ona tatala i fusi o Kisila?

verses.en: Canst thou bring forth Mazzaroth in his season? or canst thou guide Arcturus with his sons?
verses.sm: E te mafaia ea ona faaooina mai o Masarota i ona lava po? Pe e te mafaia foi onr ta‘ita‘iinma o Asa faatasi ma lana fanau?

verses.en: Knowest thou the ordinances of heaven? canst thou set the dominion thereof in the earth?
verses.sm: Ua e iloa ea tulafono i le lagi? pe na e tuuina atu: ea lana pule i le lalolagi?

verses.en: Canst thou lift up thy voice to the clouds, that abundance of waters may cover thee?
verses.sm: E te mafaia ea ona faaooina atu lou leo i ao, ia lofia ai oe i vai e tele?

verses.en: Canst thou send lightnings, that they may go, and say unto thee, Here we are?
verses.sm: E te mafaia ea ona aauina atu o uila, latou te o ai, ma latou fai mai ia te oe, Faauta, o i matou nei?

verses.en: Who hath put wisdom in the inward parts? or who hath given understanding to the heart?
verses.sm: O ai ea ua tuuina atu le poto i totonu o le tagata? Po ai foi ua na avatu le mafaufau i le loto?

verses.en: Who can number the clouds in wisdom? or who can stay the bottles of heaven,
verses.sm: O ai na te mafaia ona faitau O ao i lona poto? Po ai foi na te mafaia ona liligi ifo o fagu o le lagi,

verses.en: When the dust groweth into hardness, and the clods cleave fast together?
verses.sm: pe a liu palapala le efuefu, ma ua pipii faatasi le eleele?

verses.en: Wilt thou hunt the prey for the lion? or fill the appetite of the young lions,
verses.sm: E te mafaia ea ona tuli o se manu ia saeia má le leona? pe e te faamaoona i leona taanoa,

verses.en: When they couch in their dens, and abide in the covert to lie in wait?
verses.sm: a o latou faapuga i o latou ana, ma nofo lamalama i mea latou te fale ai?

verses.en: Who provideth for the raven his food? when his young ones cry unto God, they wander for lack of meat.
verses.sm: O ai ea na te sauni má le oreva lana mea e ‘ai, pe a fetagisi atu ana tama i le Atua, a o sé i latou ina ua leai se mea e ‘ai?
